question: Why was this group of four letters named ūṣma by Bhairava?
premises: This group of four letters shines through its own heat.
That shining is the basis of its designation.
Bhairava of pure nature declared its name to be ūṣma.
inference: Therefore the four letters are called ūṣma because their manifesting power is expressed as inner heat.
uncertainties: The referent 'group of four letters' is carried from the phonemic context rather than named explicitly in this verse.
plain_english: Because this group of four letters shines forth through its own inner heat, Bhairava of pure nature declared its name to be ūṣma.
